Yes, new night wakings around 20 months are really common. Teething, a nap change, or a burst of separation worry can all set them off. Tonight, try a short, boring check-in. Go in, keep the lights off, say one calm phrase like "night-night, I'm here," pat their back, and leave before they're fully asleep. Keep it the same every time so 2am stays dull.

If they seem sick or in pain, call Health811 at 811 any time. In an emergency, call 911.
